It looks like she intends to maintain her own pace early on.
Her plan is likely to run her own race without getting swept up by the pack.

A few days after signing my contract with Sounds of Earth,
we were devising a strategy for her upcoming mock race.

Sounds of Earth! Here comes Sounds of Earth!
It's an explosive surge, as if releasing all the energy built up until now!

My determination to become a Trainer worthy of her grew even stronger.
If I study the music she loves so dearly, perhaps I can draw closer to her...
(Chaka-chak! Chaka-chaka-chak!!)
I see, so this is where she...!
How was that performance? Would you share your thoughts with me?

Across the finish line!! Sounds of Earth takes first place!
With a furious late charge, she clinches a brilliant victory!

Ah, did you understand?
I reproduced that piece to perfection, wouldn't you say?

Because I sensed your confusione.
So I wanted you to wield the baton just as your heart desires!

If she takes a favorable position and stalks near the front,
she won't be overtaken from behind and can pull off a wire-to-wire win.

Indeed, the piece she first played for me was tempestuous and fierce,
mirroring the intense racing of the other Umamusume.

I have returned, Trainer.
How did you find today's session?

Fufu. I simply wanted to hear the answer residing within you.
And I received it loud and clear!

Judging by the rivals' training sessions, the race pace
is bound to get messy. How should we approach this...?

After holding back, building up the crescendo all at once!
Splendid, the time has come to unleash it all! Esplosione!!

There is no need to be timid. Just as you heard it, just as you felt it...
Simply surrender yourself to the notes drifting across your heart's score.
—So, won't you use these to perform your answer song?

Hmm... Bene! We cannot remain at a fermata forever!
Allow me to join in as well!

To express our race tactics through musical performance, and then execute it on the track...
I could only marvel at her incredible artistic genius.

Yet, is that truly all?
Surely something else blossomed within you.

You need not worry about the upcoming mock race in the slightest.
Simply look forward to our session!

However, some contenders possess sharp closing speed. Would waiting
and stalking with her favored late-charge style be the safer play? I just can't decide...

Grazie!
What an abbandono answer! That is truly what rose in your heart!
Haaaaaah!!

Keeping the exact same tempo throughout might bore Sounds of Earth.
Since this is an answer song to a fiery piece, I'll take a bold leap here—

Reaching the middle leg, the gap between the lead pack widened.
It seemed the front-runners had picked up their pace.

Bravo! That was a splendid session!
This answer song is bene!

Brava! That was a splendid session!
This answer song is bene!

The race enters its final stretch! Fatigue is starting to show in the front-runners!
Wait! Surging forward from the back in one sweeping rush is—

After playing her impromptu violin piece all the way through,
Sounds of Earth offered a graceful bow to a thoroughly bewildered me.

Right from the start, a fierce contest unfolds among the pack!
Meanwhile, a small group including Sounds of Earth watches calmly from behind!

An answer song, huh... Repeating the exact same style would lack artistry.
So I started softly, playing at a tempo that stood as the polar opposite of ferocious.

Starting quiet in the beginning, then bursting into a fiery climax.
It mirrored the progression of my previous answer song, but could it really be—

I gaze down at the maracas handed to me.
Unable to grasp her intentions, endless questions swirl, but—

The day of the mock race arrived.
Sounds of Earth had assured me there was nothing to worry about, yet—
